data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Real-Time Dashboard
features.description: Create a real-time dashboard with Chart.js graphs for various metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard updates in real-time with live data.
Includes line chart for LLM cost over time.
Includes bar chart for stage completion rates and area chart for success rate trends.

features.title: Chart.js Integration
features.description: Integrate Chart.js to visualize various data metrics in the Artemis demo.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are displayed using Chart.js.
Cost tracking and success rates are visualized with charts.
Charts are interactive and animated.

features.title: Feature Metrics Display
features.description: Showcase metrics for cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning using charts.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics are displayed using appropriate chart types.
Charts are accurate and up-to-date.
Information is presented clearly.

features.title: Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Display code quality metrics such as TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart accurately reflects code quality metrics.
Metrics are clear and easy to understand.
Chart is visually engaging.

features.title: Supervisor Integration Visualization
features.description: Visualize supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Pie chart accurately represents integration data.
Chart is visually appealing and easy to interpret.
Data is up-to-date and reflects current integration status.

features.title: Pipeline Visualization
acceptance_criteria: All 8 stages are represented in the visualization.
Chart is clear and easy to understand.
Stages are visually distinct.

features.title: Results Display
features.description: Show real metrics from recent runs using actual data in the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics are accurate and reflect recent data.
Data is presented in an engaging manner.
Charts are used to enhance understanding of results.

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Implement auto-advance functionality and navigation controls for the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration.
Users can manually navigate between slides using controls.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: HTML Presentation Setup
features.description: Create a standalone HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for the Artemis demo.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies.
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML file.
Chart.js is included and functional within the HTML.

features.title: HERO Slide: Introduction to Artemis
features.description: Create a HERO slide introducing Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System.
acceptance_criteria: Slide clearly explains what Artemis is.
Visuals are engaging and informative.
Content is concise and impactful.

features.title: Professional Presentation Design
features.description: Design the presentation with a professional gradient background and smooth transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Gradient background is applied consistently across slides.
Transitions between slides are smooth and professional.
Overall design aligns with professional presentation standards.
